# DSH Noema > 将本地 Noema 记忆服务接入 DSH，支持检索与跨工具导入。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[ZSeven-W/dsh-noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-noema) - **版本号**：0.1.0-rc.6（[固定提交 07d2fece531d11dbd5c420c5d44eaea12e6a9d7a](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-noema/tree/07d2fece531d11dbd5c420c5d44eaea12e6a9d7a)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-06（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定宿主桥和导入代码，未执行 MCP 或宿主。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要在 DSH 复用长期开发笔记的用户。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 统一接入记忆工具与生命周期。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) 已接受的记忆与去重账本不是同一提交。 - **建议**：[Q04](#research-q04) 在提交前显示待导入范围。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 先隔离验证。[Q02](#research-q02) 导入失败先读回。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 统一接入记忆工具与生命周期。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) 已接受的记忆与去重账本不是同一提交。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q04](#research-q04) 在提交前显示待导入范围。 检查启动、查询、导入失败及退出。 ## 场景与替代办法 需要在 DSH 复用长期开发笔记的用户。 手工检索并粘贴各工具笔记。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | |---|---|---|---| | 兼容 DSH 与 Noema | 必需 | 加载工具与服务 | 手工笔记 | | 临时记忆根 | 隔离验证需要 | 限定写入 | 不试真实内容 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 准备 | 用户设临时记忆根并关闭自动导入 | 限定来源 | | 验证 | 操作者导入合成资料 | 核对重复与读取 | | 退出 | 关闭工具并读回进程和文件 | 按需保留 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次 | 二进制和存储未知 | 配置独立路径 | 未实测 | | 持续 | 服务和索引资源未知 | 维护来源 | 资料风险需核对 | | 恢复 | 重导成本未知 | 读取账本与记忆 | 不盲重试 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | |---|---|---| | 宿主检索 | 工具与 MCP 接线 | 实际召回 | | 导入 | 来源选择和内容键 | 幂等与隔离 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：Noema 的宿主接线、导入和状态边界是什么？ ### Q01 · 记忆如何接进宿主？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 在 DSH 持续开发的用户通常手工引用其他工具的笔记。插件注册记忆工具、可选系统引导和 Web 管理。工具调用时管理器共享启动 promise，等待 MCP 运行并按超时调用；可配置启动即拉起。贡献是把跨会话记忆检索变成宿主工具，而存储和相关性仍由实际 Noema 服务决定。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:33-50](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-noema/blob/07d2fece531d11dbd5c420c5d44eaea12e6a9d7a/README.md#L33-L50) 作者的持久记忆场景
查看原文（18行） ```text ## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/index.ts:89-129](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-noema/blob/07d2fece531d11dbd5c420c5d44eaea12e6a9d7a/src/index.ts#L89-L129) 宿主注册和启动
查看原文（41行） ```text const manager = new NoemaServerManager(() => settingsSource(), ctx.logger) const importService = new MemoryImportService(manager, () => settingsSource(), ctx.logger) const disposers: Array<() => void | Promise> = [] for (const tool of createNoemaTools(manager, () => settingsSource(), importService)) { disposers.push(ctx.effect( () => hostCtx.tools.register(tool), 'dsh-noema: ' + tool.name + ' tool', )) } // Guidance section: only mounted when a systemPrompt service exists. ctx.inject(['systemPrompt'], (promptCtx) => { const systemPrompt = (promptCtx as SystemPromptContext).systemPrompt systemPrompt.section({ name: NOEMA_GUIDANCE_SECTION.name, order: NOEMA_GUIDANCE_SECTION.order, text: () => noemaGuidanceText(settingsSource()), }) }) // Status route: only mounted when a webServer service exists (headless // profiles never attach; the settings panel then hides the status card). ctx.inject(['webServer'], (webCtx) => { const webServer = (webCtx as WebServerContext).webServer return registerNoemaStatusRoute( webServer, manager, () => settingsSource(), () => settingsWriter, importService, ) }) const initial = settingsSource() if (initial.enabled && initial.autoStart) { manager.ensureRunning().catch((error: unknown) => { ctx.logger.warn('dsh-noema: ' + (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))) }) } manager.startKeepAlive() ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/server-manager.ts:147-176](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-noema/blob/07d2fece531d11dbd5c420c5d44eaea12e6a9d7a/src/server-manager.ts#L147-L176) MCP 启动与调用
查看原文（30行） ```text /** Bring the server up if it is down; concurrent callers share one spawn. */ async ensureRunning(): Promise { if (this.disposed) throw new Error('Noema memory plugin is disposed') const state = this.client?.state if (state === 'running') return if (this.starting !== undefined) { await this.starting return } this.starting = this.start() try { await this.starting } finally { this.starting = undefined } } /** Call one Noema MCP tool, starting the server on demand. */ async call(name: string, args: Record, options: NoemaServerCallOptions = {}): Promise { if (options.signal?.aborted === true) throw new McpStdioError('call aborted', { cause: options.signal.reason }) await this.ensureRunning() const client = this.client if (client === undefined || client.state !== 'running') { throw new McpStdioError('Noema memory server is not running') } const config = this.resolveConfig() try { const result = await client.callTool(name, args, { timeoutMs: config.callTimeoutMs, signal: options.signal }) this.armIdle(config) return result ```
#### 缺口 - 未执行实际二进制或检索 **影响**：不能证明相关性和宿主兼容 **进一步探讨**：以合成笔记和固定二进制核对调用 ### Q02 · 导入失败可留下什么？ **研究主题**：工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 导入选择已启用来源，先枚举全局候选，工作区候选另受开关。成功记忆调用使用 accept:true 并记录内容键，末尾统一保存账本；账本写失败前已接收的内容不会在该路径撤销。重试可能再提交同内容，实际重复取决于 Noema 服务。管理路由还要求回环及 POST 同源，不能据此判断所有 Agent 工具的调用权限。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/import-service.ts:240-277](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-noema/blob/07d2fece531d11dbd5c420c5d44eaea12e6a9d7a/src/import-service.ts#L240-L277) 来源、路径与大小范围

### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. ### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
